quizTitle: Third Conditional – Meetings and Missed Opportunities

questions.question: If we ___ (prepare) the agenda earlier, the meeting ___ (be) more productive.
If the manager ___ (send) the invitation on time, everyone ___ (attend).
We ___ (finish) the project earlier if the meeting ___ (start) on time.
If Sarah ___ (not interrupt) so often, we ___ (reach) a decision faster.
options: had not interrupted / would have reached
questions.answer: had not interrupted / would have reached

questions.question: The meeting ___ (be) more effective if everyone ___ (read) the report in advance.
If we ___ (book) a larger room, the team ___ (feel) more comfortable.
If Tom ___ (check) the projector, the presentation ___ (not fail).
options: had checked / would not have failed
had check / would not have failed
questions.answer: had checked / would not have failed

questions.question: We ___ (avoid) confusion if the chairperson ___ (clarify) the action points.
If the meeting ___ (end) earlier, we ___ (have) time for lunch together.
If I ___ (know) it was so important, I ___ (join) the meeting myself.
